description:
Non-material amendments of Planning permission ref: P2024/1873/FUL, dated: 20/11/2024. The proposed amendments comprise of the following:
- Rooflight repositioned 2030mm further from Benwell Road.
- External plant screen moved back into plant deck.
- Small existing pitched roof finish to the north-west corner of the building is replaced with a new insulated profiled cladding system.
- Existing wall cladded with insulated grey panels to match the finish of the roof panels.
- Maintenance walkways shown on drawings.
- External cabinet area has been reduced.
- Ventilation ducts included on the drawings for completeness. 
- Local exhaust ventilation and containment ductwork running above the first floor roof now shown on the drawings. 
- Two narrow flues introduced extending approximately 600 mm above the first floor. 
- Bin store removed from the drawings.
- Chemical store has been updated (to reflect the selected product). 
- External lift has been omitted and the stair landing readjusted. 
- Metal post support canopy.
status: Called in by Secretary of State
